name: request-summary
title: Request summary: internal working paper
for_each: SELECT id,number FROM requests ORDER BY number

name: search-instruction
title: Departmental search instruction: internal draft
for_each: SELECT id,number FROM requests ORDER BY number

sections.title: Scope
sections.sql: SELECT number,summary,owner FROM requests WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Searches and evidence
sections.sql: SELECT department,owner,scope,due_on,completed_on,result,evidence FROM search_tasks WHERE request_id=$1 ORDER BY due_on,id
sections.note: Record sources searched and results, including a no-records result. Return documents for review. This sheet authorises no disclosure.

name: review-schedule
title: Document review schedule: internal working paper
for_each: SELECT id,number FROM requests ORDER BY number

sections.title: Review decisions
sections.sql: SELECT d.reference,d.description,d.pages,v.disposition,v.authority,v.reason,v.reviewed_copy,v.actor FROM records d LEFT JOIN reviews v ON v.record_id=d.id WHERE d.request_id=$1 ORDER BY d.reference
sections.note: Source references and review notes are internal. An officer inspects the actual files and approves the response separately.
